Strategy & Cultural Partnerships

ENCOUNTER fosters meaningful connections
at the intersection of culture, art, design, architecture,
and the premium and luxury sectors.

Rooted in contemporary creative ecosystems, ENCOUNTER supports institutions, artists, cultural platforms and brands internationally in developing strategic partnerships.

Each collaboration is conceived with respect for artistic integrity, aligned with the ambitions of all parties involved, and designed to generate measurable, lasting impact.

Authenticity. Relevance. Excellence.

Premise

Katia Lhammi, Founder

Katia Lhammi has built her career across cultural communications and strategic partnerships. Trained in art history at the Sorbonne, she began at the Louvre museum before joining leading cultural communications agencies like Claudine Colin Communication in Paris. She later moved to New York, where she deepened her international network in art, design, and architecture.

She went on to lead communications at Carpenters Workshop Gallery in London, working closely with artists. She then joined Art Basel as Head of Strategic Partnerships Europe in Basel. For nearly a decade, she conceived and led bespoke collaborations with brands including BMW, Audemars Piguet, Ruinart, UBS, La Prairie, Vitra, and Zegna, among others.

ENCOUNTER draws on this experience to build partnerships that connect cultural ambition with strategic vision.
